about_description: Teknologappen is built by students at LTH, for students at LTH. Activities, tickets and guild life — in one place.
about_source_description: The app is developed openly. Code, decisions and documentation live on GitHub.
about_withdrawal_description: Tickets sold through Teknologappen concern events or similar leisure activities supplied on a specified date or during a specified period. Under Chapter 2, Section 11, item 12 of the Swedish Distance Contracts Act (2005:59), the statutory right of withdrawal therefore does not apply. All ticket purchases are final.
about_complaints_description: Returns are not applicable either, as we sell services and experiences. Contact the person responsible for the activity or your student guild board for more information.
